lots.title: JOSIGNACIO (Cuban, b. 1963), Large Painting
lots.description: Monumentally important Cuban neo figurative painting by Josignacio. Plastic epoxy resin on canvas painting depicting dancers and musicians. Signed lower right by artist Josignacio (born Jose Ignacio Sanches-Ruis). Josignacio is widely regarded as o ne of the most important living Latin American contemporary artists. In 1984, according to Wikipedia, Josignacio "created the 'Plastic Paint Medium' of art by mixing epoxy resins with oil colors and other pigments, resulting in a hard, glossed, 3D finish, a method which would become his identifiable style." In 2016, a painting by Josignacio sold through a London auction gallery for over $3 million, setting a global record for the highest auction price ever paid for a living Latin American ar tist, as well as making Josignacio the first living Latin American artist to sell an artwork for over $3 million. Measures 50" x 60". See images. Painting itself in fine condition. lots.title: PIERRE FRANCIS DAURA, O/C Self Portrait
lots.description: Oil on canvas self portrait painting by Pierre Daura (Spanish, 1896-1976). Daura, a Catalan artist, is well-known for his self-portraiture, including solo show retrospectives illustrating the progression of his self portraits. Dozens of Daura's lan dscape and still life paintings are listed on AskArt, but only one self-portrait (sold in 2008), as most of those prized works are in museums or private collections. (His most recently offered portrait, titled Catalan Fisherman, sold at a French au ction in 2024 for 105,000 Euros against a presale estimate of 5,000-8,000 Euros.) Undated, but a work from later in life, circa 1960s-70s. Canvas measures 17 1/2" x 24 1/2", nicely framed to 27" x 34". Provenance: From the estate of E. Stewart Co man, who obtained the work directly from Martha Daura, the artist's daughter. Coleman was a philanthropist and art patron, after whom the University of Lynchburg's Coleman Gallery at the Daura Museum of Art was named in 2024. Excellent condition. A rtwork has been restretched. shipping info This item will need to be shipped by a packing company of your choice. We maintain a list of reliable shippers, or you may choose your own.
